question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "colorful".
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Monochrome**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"colorful"** means full of colors or having a variety of bright and vivid hues. (रंगीन)
 
 
• **Example:** The garden was colorful with flowers of every shade imaginable.
 
 
• **"Monochrome"** refers to something that is either black-and-white or done in shades of a single color. (एक रंग वाला)
 
 
• **Example:** The artist's monochrome painting created a striking visual impact.
 
 
• Hence, "monochrome" is the word most opposite in meaning to "colorful."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Monochrome**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Vivid** (ज्वलंत): Producing powerful feelings or strong, clear images in the mind; bright or colorful.
 
 
• **Example:** The movie left a vivid impression on the audience.
 
 
 
 
• **Radiant** (चमकीला): Sending out light; shining brightly.
 
 
• **Example:** Her radiant smile made everyone feel welcomed.
 
 
 
 
• **Vibrant** (जीवंत): Full of energy and enthusiasm; bright and striking.
 
 
• **Example:** The vibrant colors of the festival decorations were mesmerizing.
